solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Volvo Connect's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as AWS.
metrics: Volvo Connect manages 65 million events every day, a number expected to reach two billion within two years.

“With MongoDB’s assistance, migrating to Atlas was incredibly smooth and standing up the new sharded cluster was simple.” Erik Wernqvist Lead Solution Architect, Volvo Group Connected Solutions THE SOLUTION Tracking millions of daily events Volvo Connect together with assistance from MongoDB Professional Services designed a customized migration program, which enabled it to transition 8TB of data in just 2.5 days without disrupting the business or causing downtime.

“It was reassuring to know we had the skills and expertise of the Professional Services team at our disposal to help ensure the project’s success.” Now, the data for over one million vehicles around the world that generate 65 million events daily is all stored on MongoDB Atlas and made available via a customer portal, where users can see each vehicle’s event history in real-time.

“It also offers enhanced visibility with statistics and visualizations that bring processes to life while reducing unnecessary queries and input/output operations per second (IOPs).” This reduction in IOPs has made Volvo Connect 40% more efficient and reduced response times accordingly.
“We expect to process 20 times as many events in just two years’ time – that’s two billion per day and Atlas is well placed to handle that massive increase without a problem.”
